text:
josh: deploy-bot just flagged the canary for inference-service. attempted upgrade chart inference-service 2.3.0 -> 2.4.0 failed health checks during canary (3/5 pods crashed).

deploy-bot: Canary failed for release inference-service@staging. Reason: prestop hook crashloop + image digest mismatch on sidecar (expected sha256:abcd..., got sha256:abce...). Rolling back canary. See logs: /deploy/logs/1912345679.

emma: ugh, image was pushed with a different digest after chart bump? who did the image publish?

priya: i triggered the image publish this morning but i rebased and force-pushed a small fix. maybe CI rebuilt with different base image layer.

mike-sre: crashloops look related to the post-start job timing out when connecting to redis. logs show 504 to redis-proxy. not sure if digest change caused that.

josh: two issues then: image digest drift + values change (we changed replicaProbe.timeout in values-staging). deploy-bot flagged values override diff: replicaProbe.timeout changed from 5s -> 10s in the canary values. canary used new defaults + new image.

alice: given this is in the middle of change window, we need a quick decision: rollback to 2.3.0 fully, or attempt hotpatch with pinned image digest and revert values change?

priya: we can pin the image digest in the canary chart values to the previous sha256 and rerun canary. that avoids rolling back the whole chart.

emma: but if the post-start timing is actually dependent on the new image layer (unknown), pinning might hide a real regression. and we don't have time for full investigation mid-window.

mike-sre: ops preference is rollback to last stable release for now to restore capacity. then follow up with a targeted canary for the image change outside the critical hit.

josh: agree on rollback if service impact continues. current canary only affected staging, but deploy-bot marked it as failed and blocked prod promotion.

release-bot: NOTE: promotion to prod blocked by failing canary for inference-service. Manual override requires two approvers and a documented rollback playbook.

priya: i'm confident the image variance is the culprit. i can open a hotfix PR that pins image.digest in values and reverts replicaProbe.timeout to 5s. canary would then test just the chart bump without the probe change.

alice: timeline: change window closes in 40m. If we can get a hotfix PR + green canary in 15m, we can proceed. otherwise we must rollback.

josh: ok priya — do the PR, tag me + mike-sre. i'll prepare the rollback manifest in case.

priya: PR opened: https://git.redwood.io/redwood/inference-service/pulls/4512 — includes pinned image digest and probe revert. awaiting CI.

deploy-bot: New canary attempt queued for inference-service@staging using PR-4512. Canary window: 10m.

mike-sre: running quick smoke: `kubectl logs -n staging deployment/inference-service --since=2m | tail -n 50` shows no immediate crashloops on the hotfix image in one pod.

emma: CI failed lint for helm values (minor): missing `resources.limits.cpu` in values-staging. priya can you add?

priya: fixed and pushed. CI passing.

deploy-bot: Canary succeeded for inference-service@staging (PR-4512). 5/5 pods healthy for 10m. Promotion to prod now allowed.

josh: nice work. action items: 1) backfill release notes with hotfix explanation and pinned digest 2) add a guard in release pipeline to block chart+values+image changes in same canary unless explicitly opted-in 3) update rollback playbook with digest pin step.

alice: i'll file the follow-ups in the release board. josh, please paste the rollback manifest when ready.

mike-sre: note for postmortem: investigate CI image reproducibility and registry immutability practices.

release-bot: Release notes updated for 2026-03-20: inference-service 2.4.0 (hotfix): pinned sidecar digest; reverted replicaProbe.timeout; successful canary.

priya: thanks team. closing the thread after I merge PR-4512 and trigger prod deploy in 5m. :thumbsup:

josh: ack, i'll monitor prod promotion and be on-call for 1h.

alice: thanks everyone, nice quick coordination. :rocket:
